gloss: refill; replacement; transferring to another container

definitions.explanation: The act of refilling a container, especially with products like soap, detergent, or other household items.

examples.japanese: シャンプーの{詰|つ}め{替|か}えを{買|か}った。
{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}のほうが{安|やす}い。
ボトルに{詰|つ}め{替|か}える。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{詰|つ}め (packing, filling) + {替|か}え (replacement) - from {詰|つ}める (to pack) + {替|か}える (to replace)

ECO-FRIENDLY SHOPPING:
{詰|つ}め{替|か}え products are popular in Japan for reducing plastic waste. They come in pouches ({パウチ}) that are transferred into reusable bottles.

COMMON PRODUCTS:
・シャンプー{詰|つ}め{替|か}え - shampoo refill
・{洗剤|せんざい}{詰|つ}め{替|か}え - detergent refill
・ハンドソープ{詰|つ}め{替|か}え - hand soap refill

COLLOCATIONS:
・{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう} - refill type/for refilling
・{詰|つ}め{替|か}えパック - refill pack
